ranked.headline: Explicit models extract spatial gene structure from transcriptomics and histology images
ranked.summary: Foundation models and spatially aware statistics are now applied to spatial transcriptomics at scale, including Novae, trained on ~30M cells.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve DEAD-box helicase conformational ensembles and modular architecture
ranked.summary: Scattering and in vivo data are now coupled to modeled state populations, sharpening mechanistic claims for flexible biomolecular systems.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised embeddings retain biological structure across omics and imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple autoencoders, contrastive objectives, and graph models to heterogeneous omics and clinical data, with domain constraints built in.

ranked.headline: Assay-specific workflows refine processing of long-read, single-cell and variant data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target preprocessing bottlenecks in long-read, single-cell, and variant-truth workflows, reporting runtime reductions and accuracy gains.

ranked.headline: MD Simulations Map Distal Energy Channels and Ligand Recognition Interfaces
ranked.summary: Microsecond MD and multiscale simulations now resolve distal, electrostatic, and interface contributions to protein energetics.

ranked.headline: Generative and learned models address scarce annotations in biomedical cell imaging
ranked.summary: Annotation-limited segmentation and classification pipelines now rely on synthetic data, pretrained networks, and foundation models for biomedical images.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and models predict transcriptional responses to genetic and drug perturbations
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and LLM-based predictors test whether perturbation models generalize to unassayed genes and drug responses.

ranked.headline: Open computational tools for atom provenance, stereochemistry, and molecular assembly
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers from December 2025 pair formal algorithms with open tools for atom tracing, stereochemistry, and molecular assembly.

ranked.headline: Haplotype and recombination structure carried into association and prediction tools
ranked.summary: Recent software and methods encode haplotype, crossover and LD structure from genotype data before GWAS and genomic selection analyses.

ranked.headline: Curated references and coverage-aware models refine microbiome taxonomic profiling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add curated fungal references, coverage-based profiling, and expanded vaginal gene catalogs for complex microbiomes.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided ssDNA design and differentiable RNA energy parameter estimation
ranked.summary: End-to-end backbone-to-sequence ssDNA design and gradient-based RNA energy fitting mark recent structure-informed nucleic acid modeling.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking how protein and complex structure encodings perform in affinity prediction
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether co-folding outputs and learned structure encodings can support accurate protein binding and affinity predictions.

ranked.headline: Explicit frameworks formalize cortical mapping, fly vision, and neural decoding
ranked.summary: Benchmarked computational frameworks now address retinotopic, connectome-constrained, and intracranial neural decoding problems in parallel.

ranked.headline: Software tools connect omics outputs to candidate genes, enzymes and expression data
ranked.summary: Integrated platforms now couple multi-omics repositories, metabolic models and GWAS evidence packaging within single, standardized analysis workflows.

ranked.headline: Systematic evaluation of analytical choices in single-cell RNA-seq analysis
ranked.summary: Gene selection, batch correction, and pseudobulk FDR control in scRNA-seq are now assessed by systematic benchmarks rather than single models.

ranked.headline: LLM agents automate genomic, transcriptomic, and single-cell data interpretation
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM systems now wrap established bioinformatics steps, from GFF queries to cell annotation, in natural-language interfaces.

ranked.headline: Simulated ground truth benchmarks evaluate sequencing analysis tools across methods
ranked.summary: Simulators with known ground truth now allow controlled, reproducible assessment of sequencing software, including an 86-tool RNA modification benchmark.

ranked.headline: Sequence criteria refine bacterial taxonomy and detect mutations and gene transfer
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply phylogenomic, k-mer, and read-based sequence methods to bacterial taxonomy, transfer, and resistance detection.

ranked.headline: GWAS frameworks now separate pleiotropy, epistasis and gene-environment effects
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale and multitrait datasets now support explicit modelling of functional, interaction and pleiotropic genetic architecture.

ranked.headline: Single-cell transcriptomics maps cell-type-specific regulation and disease risk
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases and scalable eQTL and risk-modeling methods now resolve disease-relevant genetic and cell-state effects at cell-type resolution.

ranked.headline: ML models for bioactivity and ADMET prediction with explicit uncertainty handling
ranked.summary: Uncertainty propagation and calibrated confidence now shape compound prioritization across bioactivity, ADMET and PBPK modeling.

ranked.headline: k-mer indexing and sketching methods for storage, mapping, and ancient DNA authentication
ranked.summary: Recent items address k-mer compression, sketching, and damage-aware alignment for large sequence collections and ancient DNA.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and genomic models predict oncologic outcomes and actionable cancer drivers
ranked.summary: Compact, individualized, and agent-based models now predict oncologic outcomes from genomic, transcriptomic, histologic, and clinical data.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of protein localization and secretory function from proteomics
ranked.summary: Open-source tools now infer protein localization from spatial and organelle profiling data, alongside curated secretory pathway reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Generative augmentation and multidomain transfer for peptide immunogenicity prediction
ranked.summary: Sparse labeled peptide datasets motivate generative augmentation and adversarial transfer for immunogenicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked scoring of transcriptomic features across bulk, single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend benchmarked quantitative scoring of RNA-seq features from bulk gene sets to isoform switching and spatial ligand-receptor data.

ranked.headline: Neural surrogates trained on mechanistic reaction and metabolic dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair neural approximators with explicit reaction or pathway structure, raising the question of when learned surrogates can be trusted.

ranked.headline: Software platforms standardize, visualize and benchmark omics analysis outputs
ranked.summary: Reproducible omics work increasingly depends on packaging derived outputs, annotations and benchmarks into shared, inspectable software layers.

ranked.headline: Computational methods refine variant calls, annotation, and curation after detection
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair population frequencies, phenotype ontologies, and ClinVar updates with post-calling variant interpretation workflows.

ranked.headline: Adapted language-model features predict glycation sites, acidophilic proteins, promoters
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair pretrained DNA and protein embeddings with augmentation, prompt learning, and sparse experts for biological sequence tasks.

ranked.headline: Privacy-preserving and scalable mixed-model methods for genome-wide association analysis
ranked.summary: Scalable mixed-model and multi-omics methods now pair statistical efficiency with distributed, privacy-preserving computation on sensitive genotype data.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic data map context-specific regulatory effects on traits and disease
ranked.summary: Multi-omic maps now resolve regulatory effects by context, linking variation to egg-laying traits and human disease heritability.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked simulation and screening choices for GPCR activation and drug residence time
ranked.summary: Explicit, benchmarked protocol choices increasingly determine how reproducible free-energy and pre-screening predictions are in structure-based drug design.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and tools for statistical and ML analysis of omics and rhythm data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark ML and statistical pipelines for microbiome and metaproteomic data, alongside a no-code circadian rhythm analysis tool.

ranked.headline: Long-read and single-cell methods pair with comparative analysis of genome architecture
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair long-read and single-cell measurements of chromosome-scale organisation with comparisons across lineages.

ranked.headline: ML and simulations reveal GPCR activation pathways and lipid allosteric binding
ranked.summary: Interpretable ML and deep learning applied to MD and ligand design now resolve GPCR conformational transitions and allosteric sterol modulation.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link transposons and structural variation to genome size
ranked.summary: Long-read and chromosome-level assemblies now resolve structural variation and genome size across flatworms, termites, and scrub-jays.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative design extends to nucleases and antibody repertoires
ranked.summary: Structure-guided generative workflows are now being applied beyond catalysis to nuclease scaffolds, antibody repertoires, and epitope-specific binders.

ranked.headline: Reference genome quality shapes single-nucleus, variant, and stress-trait genomic analyses
ranked.summary: Complete, haplotype-resolved assemblies and language-model variant scoring are now being tied directly to transcriptomic and variant-level readouts.

ranked.headline: Force fields and environment-resolved sampling refine ion, pH and torsional energetics
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom force-field, constant-pH and small-molecule torsion studies address how environment shapes simulated molecular energetics.
